activity.notes: Broad disputed historical-setting window for Gideon/Jerubbaal in pre-monarchic Israel. The late twelfth/early eleventh-century Yrb‘l inscription is not identified with Gideon; it is treated only as contextual evidence that the name existed in the relevant Iron Age I horizon.

sources.title: Rollston et al., “The Jerubba‘al Inscription from Khirbet al-Ra‘i” (2021)
sources.citation_text: Publishes a Yrb‘l (Jerubba‘al) inscription from a late twelfth/early eleventh-century BCE context. The inscription is not identified as Gideon; it is used only as onomastic and chronological-context evidence.
